description: The Windparkkarte Schweiz is an interactive map published by the Swiss Foundation for Landscape Conservation (SL-FP) showing where wind parks are planned or projected in Switzerland and in the neighbouring border areas. The page read on 2026-09-28 explains that the map draws on a shared information platform of six environmental organisations (Pro Natura, WWF, BirdLife Switzerland, SL-FP, Helvetia Nostra and Mountain Wilderness) and the Swiss Alpine Club, in which publicly available data on wind energy planning are registered, exchanged and continuously updated; the page also offers the foundation's 2018 position paper on landscape protection and wind turbines. Coverage is Switzerland and adjacent areas abroad. Access is free in the browser; no licence or download is stated. Caveats: the map is compiled by advocacy organisations from public planning documents, project stages may lag official permitting records, and a second request on the same day returned a 404, so the link may move. It supports capacity planning and environmental impact screening of future Swiss wind generation sites. No related Swiss wind planning record is catalogued.
